A video has been circulating claiming to show speaker of the house, Mike Johnson saying that the SAVE act would reduce voter turn out by 18% That information is not true. The video shows Mike Johnson, and Louisiana governor Jeff Landry discussing the expected turnout for a Louisiana state constitutional amendment, but is being reported as evidence that Mike Johnson confirmed that the SAVE act would reduce turn out.
